limitations: A negative stopping result rejects promotion on the unchanged finite-panel criterion. It does not qualify unseen families, declare fallback universally sufficient or complete the milestone.

protocol.futility: If even replacing every unfinished paired gain with its mathematical maximum 1 leaves the 40-pair median below .10, promotion is impossible on this locked panel. Stop as negative qualification evidence; do not claim a complete panel or compute positive uncertainty claims from the stopped sample.
protocol.primary: Median paired H IoU difference, landmark minus geometric fallback, at least .10 in each predeclared family.
protocol.promotion: Only complete recovery/uncertainty criteria plus separately valid efficiency/absolute-resource, overlap, stability and out-of-sample evidence can promote the original NUMEK method. Failure retains the fallback; neither implementation nor promotion success is presumed.
protocol.resources: Identical two-thread default absolute admission budgets and complete fresh-process workers. Concurrent-host timings/RSS are recorded but cannot establish the required controlled <=2x runtime and <=1.5x memory comparison.
protocol.secondary: Positive paired uncertainty lower bounds in both families; no overall median IoU regression greater than .05.
protocol.selection: Unchanged native S selection; no H or oracle gate selection.
protocol.uncertainty: 20000 paired seed-bootstrap medians, Bonferroni two-sided intervals across two families. Also require a positive conservative distribution-free order-statistic median lower bound under IID seed pairs; ties do not supply a coverage theorem for the bootstrap.
